description: Kilo Code vs self-hosted Coder Agents vs GitHub Copilot agent mode: which local-friendly coding agent fits solo builders, regulated teams, and editor-first developers.
lead: Verdict first: pick Kilo Code for local-first solo work with open source and local models, self-hosted Coder Agents for regulated teams that must keep agent and execution inside their own perimeter including air-gapped setups, and GitHub Copilot agent mode for editor-first developers who want autonomous multi-step coding inside the tools they already use. The grid and tests below show why.
title: Local Coding Agents Compared: Kilo Code vs Coder Agents vs Copilot Agent Mode
